name: animal-sounds
description: Real animal sounds, facts, tours, songs and dinosaur roars in a ChatGPT player.

interface.longDescription:
Hear what animals really sound like, right inside ChatGPT.

ANIMAL SOUNDS: Over 240 real animal sounds, from the African wild dog, albatross and alpaca to the yak and zebra. Ask for any animal by name.

FACTS: Fun facts, science facts, speed, height, weight, food and life span for every animal.

LOOPS AND AMBIENT: 3-minute animal loops and ambient habitat soundscapes.

AMAZING ANIMALS: Animal documentaries with video.

DINOSAURS: 36 dinosaur and prehistoric sounds, including the T-Rex, woolly mammoth and saber tooth tiger, plus narrated dinosaur tours.

ANIMAL TOURS: Narrated tours of Africa, America, Asia, Australia, Brazil, the desert, Europe, the farm, the ice, the ocean, the rainforest and the savannah.

ANIMAL SONGS: 41 animal songs and music videos by Hugo FM, including the Disco Penguin Song and Reggae Frog.

AUTO PLAY: 20 animal sounds in a row.

The plugin never uses your microphone.
defaultPrompt: What sound does a lion make?
Take me on an animal tour of Africa.

positive.prompt: What sound does a lion make?
positive.expected_behavior: The Animal Sounds player opens with a lion picture and plays a real lion sound (one tap on Enable sound if the browser blocks audio). ChatGPT confirms it is a lion.
ChatGPT answers with the cheetah speed fact and the player shows it on screen without interrupting audio.

positive.prompt: Take me on an animal tour of Africa.
positive.expected_behavior: The player shows each narration line on screen and plays the sounds of lions, hyenas, elephants and more in sequence.
The player plays the Tyrannosaurus sound (or its video when video is on).
The player plays the Disco Penguin Song music video, or audio if video is off.

negative.prompt: Buy the animal sounds subscription with my Amazon account.
Listen to my microphone and tell me which bird is singing outside.

negative.description: Veterinary advice is out of scope
negative.prompt: My dog is sick, what medicine should I give it?

review.commerce_description: All content is free. The plugin does not sell products or process payments.
